entities.summary: Lake Boon Tsagaan is a large endorheic lake located in southern Mongolia. It is the largest lake in the Govi (Gobi) region and one of the principal surface water bodies in the Valley of Lakes. The lake plays an important role in the hydrological system of the Central Asian internal drainage basin through its connection with the Baidrag River.
